title: Smaller pattern drift, grouped
foundBy: an independent reviewer agent, asked to assess whether the patterns had drifted from the design system
details:
Five small ones, none worth a record alone.

`MasterDetailDemo` omits `wrap: true` on its three StatusBadge columns while its own spec has it. `components/Table.md` says a column holding structured elements must set it, because a non-wrapping cell is clipped and offered through a tooltip whose content is the same badge again. Nothing clips at the widths tested, since the tables do not set `fixed`, so the symptom is latent rather than visible.

The Chart demo's hand-rolled Recharts tooltip loses its shadow: the rule it points at sets two undefined Tailwind variables and no `box-shadow`. Side by side with a real ChartTooltip on the same page, one has a shadow and one does not.

`patterns/FormResults.md` prescribes a spinner while results load, which `patterns/ComponentStates.md` lists as an anti-pattern in favour of skeletons.

Two documents cite `OPEN.md`, which does not exist: that content became the ledger.

`components/Legend.md` claims patterns that do not mention it, and omits Dashboard, which is the one that needs a legend.
